name: Clustering edge time series
summary: Builds edge time series from regional fMRI time series (products of z-scored node signals) and clusters time points with k-means, outputting the cluster label of each frame.
description: Reads a regional time-series TSV, drops all-zero columns, z-scores the data, forms edge time series as element-wise products for every region pair, and clusters the frames into nclus clusters with SciPy kmeans2. Use it for edge-centric analysis of fMRI functional connectivity states.

inputs.description: Regional fMRI time series as a TSV table (time points by regions).

outputs.description: CSV of the cluster label assigned to each time point, plus label.json mapping edge IDs to region pairs.

citations.text: Faskowitz J, Esfahlani FZ, Jo Y, Sporns O, Betzel RF. Edge-centric functional network representations of human cerebral cortex reveal overlapping system-level architecture. Nat Neurosci (2020).
Esfahlani FZ, Jo Y, Faskowitz J, Byrge L, Kennedy DP, Sporns O, Betzel RF. High-amplitude cofluctuations in cortical activity drive functional connectivity. PNAS (2020).
